title: UPD 3 ACS  Auto Farm Auto Reroll inf Talent OP Script
features:
*Auto Farm
   [+] Auto Farm select
        - Select World
        - Select Enemy
        - Auto Join World Select
        - Teleport [Farm in Range]
        - Teleport  in Range [Setting Distance]
   [+] Auto Farm Tower
        - Auto  Farm Tower
        - Auto  Collect Chest [Tower]
   [+] Auto Farm Raid
        - Have Raid Status [Raid Room Cooldown or Ready]
        - Select Raids
        - Select Difficulty
        - Private Room
        - Collect Chest [After Finish]
        - Go On The Head [Mob]
        - Auto Farm Raid
*Pet
   [+] Pet Setting - Feed
        - Select Pet
        - Select Rarity
        - Auto Feed
   [+] Pet Setting - Quirk
        - Quirk Status
        - Select Pet
        - Select Quirk
        - Select Slot
        - Premium Medal  [Select Premium  Medal to use ]
        - Auto Reroll Quirk
   [+] Pet Setting - Talent
        - Talent Status
        - Select Pet
        - Select Talent
        - Auto Reroll Talent
   [+] Pet Setting - Essence 
        - Select Rarity [Essence ]
        - Ignore Godly [Not Delete Godly]
        - Auto Essence [3 sec]
*Egg & Items
   [+] Egg & Items - Egg
        - Select World [Egg]
        - Auto Open Egg
   [+] Egg & Items - Item [Scrap Skin]
        - Select Rarity Skin
        - Auto Scrap Skin
*Teleport
   [+] Teleport to World
        - Teleport to All World [Need to Unlock worlds first]
   [+] Teleport to Hub
       - Teleport to Magic Tree
       - Teleport to Tower
       - Teleport to Raids
       - Teleport to Cosmics
       - Teleport to Machines
*Theme
   [+] Color
       - Setting and Custom UI Display
   [+] Setting
       - Rejoin
       - Hop Server
       - Select FPS Amount
       - Enable FPS Cap
       - Enable Low CPU Mode
       - Keyblind Hide UI
